newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African Q4 GDP rises 3.3 pct, full year 3.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.African Q4 GDP rises 3.3 pct, full year 3.1 pct.

text.p: South African gross domestic product (GDP) rose a seasonally adjusted and annualised 3.3 percent in the fourth quarter of 1996 against 3.2 percent in the third quarter, the Central Statistical Service said.
The fourth quarter rise brought GDP growth for 1996 to 3.1 percent compared with a revised 3.4 percent in 1995. The CSS had previously estimated 1995 GDP growth at 3.3 percent.
The figures are at constant 1990 market prices.
A Reuters poll of economists forecast a fourth quarter rise of 3.3 percent.
